description: Shopify store — orders with first/last-visit attribution, line items, refunds, products and variants

shopify_orders.description: Orders: totals, status, channel, customer_id, shipping city/region/country (no personal details)

shopify_order_attribution.description: Per-order customer journey: first/last visit source, landing page, referrer, UTMs

shopify_order_lines.description: Order line items: product, variant, SKU, quantity, totals

shopify_products.description: Products: type, vendor, status, inventory, price range

sales_last_30_days.description: Daily sales for the last 30 days
sales_last_30_days.sql: SELECT * FROM shopify_sales_daily WHERE date >= date('now', '-30 days') ORDER BY date

orders_by_first_source.description: Orders and net sales by first-visit source, last 90 days
orders_by_first_source.sql: SELECT first_source, first_medium, SUM(orders) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM shopify_sales_by_source_daily WHERE date >= date('now', '-90 days') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY net_sales DESC

api_integration.authentication: Dev Dashboard app (client credentials grant) or admin custom-app access token
api_integration.rate_limits: Cost-based: 1,000-point bucket per store (more on Plus), refilling per second
